select t.id, t.title, t.user_id, t.comments, t.view, t.collects, t.top, t.essence, t.likes, t.create_time, t.modify_time, t.cover_img, u.username, u.alias, u.avatar
/* 综合热度公式计算 */ ,(log(ifnull(t.likes,1)+1)*0.5 + t.comments*0.3 + t.collects*0.2) as hot_score
from post t left join user u on t.user_id = u.id
date(t.create_time) <= date_add(curdate(), interval 1 day) and date(t.create_time) >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 10 day)
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC
ORDER BY hot_score DESC, t.create_time DESC
select * from post t where t.id != #{id} order by rand(), t.view limit 10

select t.id, t.title, t.user_id, t.comments, t.view, t.collects, t.top, t.essence, t.likes, t.create_time, t.modify_time, t.cover_img, u.username, u.alias, u.avatar from post t left join user u on t.user_id = u.id
t.id in
#{item}
ORDER BY t.modify_time DESC, t.create_time DESC

select t.id as topic_id, t.title as topic from post t left join collect c on t.id = c.topic_id
t.id in
#{item}
ORDER BY t.modify_time DESC, t.create_time DESC
